description: Visualize embedded linker map files (GNU ld / LLVM lld) as a sortable, filterable symbol list with C++ demangling. Flash/RAM usage at a glance.
configuration.demangle.description: Demangle C++ symbol names (built-in WASM demangler, no toolchain required).
configuration.formatOverride.description: Force the map file format instead of auto-detection.
configuration.clickAction.description: What a plain click on a symbol row does. Alt+click always performs the other action; double-click always reveals the line in the raw map.
configuration.clickAction.locate: Reveal the symbol's line in the raw map (opens the text pane beside the view on demand).
configuration.clickAction.copy: Copy the displayed symbol name to the clipboard.
